# KDBX golden interop fixtures

`reference_aes_argon2.kdbx` is generated by an **independent** implementation
(pykeepass) so dgvault's reader is tested against real third-party output.

- KDBX 4, cipher AES-256, KDF Argon2d (I=14, M=64 MiB, P=2), gzip,
  ChaCha20 inner random stream.
- Password: `correct horse battery staple`
- Regenerate: `pip install --user pykeepass && python3 generate_reference.py`
  (run from the repo root). Used by `test/core/crypto/kdbx_keepassxc_golden_test.dart`.

Bidirectional interop (pykeepass reading a dgvault-written file) was verified
manually — see reviews/Performer-round-23.md.

`reference_kdbx3.kdbx` is a hand-built **KDBX 3.1** file (AES-256-CBC, AES-KDF,
Salsa20 inner stream, gzip) — generated by `generate_kdbx3.py` and validated by
pykeepass — used by `test/core/crypto/kdbx3_reader_test.dart` to exercise legacy
KDBX3 read support. Password: `kdbx3pass`.
